Russia's Ministry of Defense announced that the rollout ceremony for the newest Project 885M Yasen-M nuclear-powered attack submarine, Ulyanovsk, was held at the Sevmash shipyard in Severodvinsk. The submarine is scheduled to join the Northern Fleet.
Ulyanovsk will now undergo final outfitting afloat, followed by a comprehensive series of sea trials before entering service.
Ulyanovsk is the sixth Project 885M Yasen-M submarine and the seventh vessel in the class overall, including the lead boat. Three additional Project 885M submarines are currently under construction and are also expected to join the Northern and Pacific Fleets.

Wildfires in France are threatening military facilities involved in the production of solid rocket motors for the M51 submarine-launched nuclear ballistic missile (SLBM).
Large wildfires in the Gironde region of southwestern France have approached the CESTA (CEA/DAM) facility and ArianeGroup's site in Saint-Médard-en-Jalles, where solid rocket motors for the M51 SLBM are produced.
The fires have also threatened Dassault Aviation's plant in Martignas-sur-Jalle, which manufactures Rafale fighter components, and its assembly facility in Bordeaux-Mérignac.
Authorities launched large-scale evacuations, with 55,000 people displaced on Sunday night and 220,000 evacuated in total.
Dassault Aviation relocated sensitive equipment from Martignas-sur-Jalle and its Cesta logistics center to Mérignac and Air Base 106. ArianeGroup evacuated its facilities west of Bordeaux and implemented protective measures.
Firefighting operations remain underway with significant emergency response resources deployed.

The Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) are withdrawing from all checkpoints in and around the city of Hasakah, as well as Mabdah in the Qamishli countryside, and are handing them over to the Syrian Internal Security Forces.
Meanwhile, the Sotoro forces, the Syriac Military Council, and the Khabur Guards, formations affiliated with the Kurdish-led SDF, are being integrated into the Syrian Ministries of Interior and Defense.
The integration is being carried out on an individual basis, with officers retaining their current ranks.
